title: huge shaggy argentinian jerusalem artichokes hash
description: a resinous, shaggy, kid-friendly argentinian dish featuring jerusalem artichokes, dehydrate, shojin-friendly
instructions: peel the jerusalem artichokes and dice them into small pieces.
in a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
add the diced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, until fragrant.
add the diced jerusalem artichokes, salt, black pepper, cumin, and paprika.
stir to combine, then transfer the mixture to a baking dish.
cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
remove the foil and continue baking for another 20 minutes, until the jerusalem artichokes are tender.
let the mixture cool slightly, then fluff it with a fork to create a shaggy texture.
serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
